card.text: The brightest of Uranus's five large moons, with the youngest surface.

introduction.text: Fault-bounded valleys cut across Ariel. It has few large craters and was likely the most recently active of Uranus's larger moons.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness correction evens out broad shading; local shadows and seams remain.

elevation.title: Stereo, shading and limb terrain model
elevation.summary: Heights from stereo images, shading and the moon's outline; detail varies.
